title: Weird characters in terminal after 0.2.1

labels.name: bug-regression
labels.description: wrong behavior that was introduced in a previous commit (please bisect)

body:

## Vim (version: ) behaves differently?
Vim 8.0.628 with `vim -u NONE` behaves properly.

## Operating system/version:
Arch Linux x86-64
## Terminal name/version:
Guake Terminal 0.8.10
Cannot reproduce on gnome-terminals
## `$TERM`:
xterm-256color

## Steps to reproduce using `nvim -u NORC`

```
nvim -u NORC
// press i
// input some characters
// Observe that weird characters appears
```

### Actual behaviour

![screenshot from 2017-07-11 11-59-48](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/8121231/28050591-30324096-6631-11e7-88fa-e584984e27ca.png)
![screenshot from 2017-07-11 12-00-03](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/8121231/28050707-e80e3fe4-6631-11e7-87da-d06b93498a5b.png)

### Expected behaviour
No weird characters.

## Addition
Ran `valgrind --track-origins=yes --leak-check=full nvim -u NONE 2>/tmp/record.txt`. Here is the log:
[record.txt](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/files/1137699/record.txt). Not sure whether it is related to #4796 since the same error is reported on gnome-terminal which works well.
